comments: Thirty-six healthy volunteers of Caucasian origin (15 males, 21 females, age 20–33 years, body weight 54–88 kg) of good health as evidenced by history, physical examination, routine chemical and hematologic screening, and assessment of 12lead electrocardiogram were included into the study after they had given informed written consent.
